hero.title: Trusted FMCG Distributor for Business and Consumer Needs in Indonesia
hero.subtitle: PT. Rusindo Prima Food Industri provides various food and beverage products with competitive prices, stable distribution, and wide coverage for retail, resellers, and business partners throughout Indonesia.

about.title: About Rusindo
about.description1: PT. Rusindo Prima Food Industri was established in 1981 and started as a home business that grew into a food manufacturing and FMCG distribution company.
about.description2: Operating on an area of 30,000 m² in North Sumatra, Rusindo produces various quality food products such as wafers, snacks, stick noodles, sauces, and other products.
about.description3: Rusindo products have been widely distributed to the domestic market and since 2012 have also reached international markets, including Korea, Taiwan, Cambodia, and Vietnam.

supplier.title: Partnership with Suppliers
supplier.description: PT. Rusindo Prima Food Industri opens long-term cooperation opportunities with suppliers who can meet quality standards and company raw material requirements.

distribution.title: Marketing & Distribution
distribution.description: PT. Rusindo Prima Food Industri opens marketing and distribution cooperation opportunities with partners throughout Indonesia and abroad.

description.title: Rusindo Product Distribution
description.paragraph1: PT. Rusindo Prima Food Industri products are distributed through PT. Multi Agung Sukses (MAS) as the official sole distributor.
description.paragraph2: Along with business growth, PT. Multi Agung Sukses has expanded and currently has six branches in various regions of North Sumatra.
description.paragraph3: To expand national distribution coverage, PT. Rusindo collaborates with various distributors in Surabaya, Kalimantan, Jakarta, West Java, Central Java, Makassar, and Nusa Tenggara.
